reviews_5s:
I have looked everywhere for what they call the sunflower pattern of the little tiny plates and could only find them with the mugs.

Saw the all negative reviews for the mugs with the plates and I had to respond. For me the handles were perfect, fit two of my fingers. I am able to hold the mug well. I love the tiny plates.

The plate is the perfect size for a small breakfast, snacks or just putting the mug on it. A sandwich, muffins, I even had a scoop of homemade ice cream on it.

My favorite thing is seeing the bright orange juice in the mug for breakfast. The dots and patterns are fun to watch light shine through them.

Because of others negative reviews of the extreme heat. I have been careful with them. If I am going to use them for something hot, I will run them under warm then hot water before putting a hot drink in them. I have put a fried egg straight from the pan on the plate. I have used them for rice pudding, smoothies, smoothie bowls, salads or all sorts. Food prep, whipping up an egg, holding food to weigh. I love them.

I wish they had dinner plates with the sunflower dot pattern. I would really love having a small set to enjoy more than small meals on them.They are beautiful and I love the large size of these glasses. I like my big cup of tea! I also love the spoons. Beautiful gold color!Elegance, glamorous, strong decor...Beautiful, love the look and feel of themDefinitely the prettiest glass cup! Looks perfect from all angles. The handle is a bit small for the cup but I think it will be working just fine 🙏🏻One of the things that I like about this cup is the saucer, I love that I am able to add a pastry on the saucer. The gold rim makes it look rich; the quality is good and its surprisingly heavy. The coffee temperature is good, its coffee from a coffee maker, I haven't used it with hot tea, yet which would be a hotter temperature.Beautiful elegant coffee cup. It comes with a golden spoon.So beautiful! They remind me of my grandma's mugs from when I was young. I bought three sets—six mugs total. They have a good weight and stack well. After three months of use, they are still sparkling bright with no buildup in the design.GREAT HOT COCOA GLASSES, WORTH THE BUYI was seeing these mugs for a while and I purchased them on a prime deal day. I am very happy with them. They look elegant. Each came with a gold spoon. I think I would like a plate to go with them (but I didn’t see that option when purchasing them).
reviews_1s:
Sooooo if you put any warm beverage in three cups (and I do mean warm)— it will crack the cups.

The first time I poured coffee into one, it cracked completely down the middle. I ordered a replacement (Idk why—I should have just returned it) and am too scared to put anything warm in it. All I use them for is coffee pictures on Instagram, haha!

Soo they’re fine if you just want decorative glassware or to use for cold beverages. But if you actually want to use them for coffee or warm beverages…you’re gonna want to pass on these!I bought multiple sets of these tea cups and saucers and finally used them today when we had guests for brunch. The minute we poured coffee into one of the cups, it cracked down the middle from the heat and started seeping out coffee onto the saucer and table. I don’t understand how it couldn’t withstand the heat of the coffee if that’s what it’s made to do. The most basic function of this product doesn’t work. Unfortunately, my return window closed and now I have 9 other sets of this product that I’m scared to use in front of guests. While they’re not the most expensive product, they’re far from cheap. Would not recommend.I wish I had read the reviews before I used these glasses. AS SOON as I put hot water in the glass for my tea, it broke and tea spilled all over the place. I was so upset.

The glasses are beautiful but definitely not meant for hot beverages.FIRST/FIRST time use! Filled with soup and heard a "crack". Soup everywhere and the mug is in two pieces. Clearly not meant for hot liquids.First order arrived without the spoons and it was the spoons that tempted me to order, they look kind of cool. Replacement sent WITH spoons Yea!
However, the self-destruct must've been activated. Nothing indicated not safe for dishwasher but both were reduced to little pieces of glass all over the inside of my dishwasher.I bought this set back in May. I used them for the first time today, I poured hot water to make tea and the cup cracked, hot water everywhere. This set is for decorative purposes only, not for practical use.. If your idea is utilize them for hot tea or coffee, don’t buy. You’ll be greatly disappointed.The mugs were securely shipped, placed into the custom styro packaging that fits into the product packaging box. However, one of the mugs in the pair I received had a significant dent in the glass. The dent is located on the base, it is a defect that occurred in the manufacturing process. Your eye can't miss the defect. It was purchased for a gift, and it is not suitable for gifting. Will be returning.The first cup I blamed myself. The little insulation seal broke off while I was washing it and dishwater filled the cup. However, it seemed to happen to the second cup when I was pouring in a hot tea. it popped underneath while the glass was on my counter. the tea stayed in so I decided it's just what happens to insulated cups. Then I see the cup is broken in the inside. I threw the broken cup away before I realized I could return but I will be returning the second for my refund. I was very much in love with these cups until they failed at every turn.I really love the look but this is the second glass that has been broken - first was upon receiving in the mail which was replaced when returning the damaged one, the second was upon using it for hot tea. There has to be a weakness in the glass somewhere and definitely dangerous since this is probably only the 8th time total I’ve used it! Always hand washed and of course I’m outside of the return window. Disappointing.First time I went to use it, I poured hot water for tea into it and the glass split open right down the middle. It’s advertised for use with coffee/tea, but definitely cannot handle extreme temperatures. They’re still very cute, and the spoons were a nice bonus as a sugar spoon. Can still be used for yogurt.
